svg.aria-label: Shelfware — counts the shelf. The join sweeps a shelf of amber ‘tokenised’ boxes: those with a market turn green, the rest turn grey. 476 of 791 tokenised underlyings on CoinMarketCap, 60 percent, have no wrapper with a CMC-tracked market; 673 of 1,435 wrappers are untracked, 632 of Backed Assets' 772.
svg.title: Shelfware — 60% of tokenised assets on CoinMarketCap have no wrapper with a tracked market
